574-2459-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
574-2459-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-2459-5006-8170.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2577-5670-6273.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6273.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2842-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
2842-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Blood Artist triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

5088-5148-6798-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
5088-5148-6798-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5148-6798-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

2292-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2292-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3698-4559-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3698-4559-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
When the Munitions token enters, Grinding Station triggers. Resolve the Grinding Station triggers from this step and step 2, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
When the Scrap enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-4050-7195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

149-1330-2757--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-1330-2757--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

997-6761-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

1323-3143-4762-7014.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and North Pole Patrol each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1323-3143-4762-7014.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

2866-4708-4986-5256.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1286-2438-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-4029.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-4029.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3122-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Undercover Operative
3122-3362.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Undercover Operative's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

372-1971-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Yannik
You have enough mana to cast Yannik
372-1971-4200.description:
Cast Yannik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying its mana cost.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Yannik.
Yannik leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Yannik.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2131-5014-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5014-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Putrid Imp by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2265-6006-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2265-6006-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2265-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

509-1267-2750-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2750-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

3197-4304-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen.
3197-4304-4875.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Conspiracy, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

1328-2011-3263-4036.notablePrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to Najeela.
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela.
1328-2011-3263-4036.description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Najeela.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Seething Song without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {5}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.

1881-4050-4871-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

672-2145.description: Erayo counters the first spell cast, and Eidolon of Rhetoric only lets player cast one spell a turn.
